name: B10-0105/2025 (PfE) – Escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for action on the violence in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. It condemns the seizure of the city of Goma by the M23 rebel group, which it says Rwanda backs, and demands Rwanda stop supporting the rebels. It asks the European Union to suspend its minerals deal with Rwanda and review its financial support to Rwanda. It also wants more humanitarian aid and a training mission for the Congolese army. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to suspend its minerals deal with Rwanda and review aid to Rwanda.
- It affects Rwanda's government, the rebels, and civilians displaced in eastern Congo.
- Next, the Parliament sends its demands to the EU Council, Commission and others; they decide whether to act.
